findings.reason: Captive portal client API (RFC 8908), not a configuration endpoint: answers only to GET with 'Accept: application/captive+json' and the zoneid/X-Forwarded-Host headers set by the portal proxy; HTTP 400 otherwise is intended.
findings.evidence: CaptivePortal/Api/AccessController.php apiAction (26.7); HTTP 400 on 26.7 and 26.1.6 test VMs, 2026-11-11

findings.reason: Upstream web server issue: large responses arrive with broken chunked encoding over HTTP/1.1 (cut after 64 KiB); complete over HTTP/2. The verifier uses HTTP/1.1 on purpose so the issue stays visible elsewhere.
findings.evidence: curl --http1.1 exit 56 vs --http2 complete for firmware/info (26.7, 69 plugins); firewall/log on 26.7 test VM, 2026-11-11

findings.reason: Upstream plugin issue in os-udpbroadcastrelay on the 25.7 and 26.1 series: settings/get returns HTTP 500; works on 26.7.
